_source: Meta, Google, Bing, Tiktok Feeds SOP (Google Drive, Larianne), tabs for googleshoppingfs and googleshoppingfrenchfitness. Transcribed 2026-09-07. This is the MultiFeeds ruleset the two live primaries are built from; the Phase 2 generator reproduces it so cutover does not silently change feed scope.
_note: Every field name below resolves against live Shopify: vendor, productType, status, tags, variant price, variant inventory, collection membership, and the custom.condition_state / custom.3rd_party / custom.shipping_weight_lbs metafields. All metafield keys were confirmed to exist on the PRODUCT owner type on 2026-09-07.

include.vendor: all except the excluded new-only vendors below

phase2_deltas._ref: Tim, 2026-09-06, "Phase 2 feed build - GMC status after today + spec deltas".
phase2_deltas.labels: custom_label_3 = priority tier, custom_label_4 = series, series only where price >= 1000. Joined from the supplemental_priority_labels_v2.csv lookup. The generator refuses to run without that file - dropping custom_label_4 takes the Product Lines asset groups dark.
phase2_deltas.titles: SKU-keyed overrides from feeds/hero-title-overrides.csv win over the Shopify title.
phase2_deltas.shipping: Owned by the missing-shipping pass (scripts/feed_missing_shipping_fix.py on claude/missing-shipping-feed-repoint-4yg4rr). 50 rows still need rates from Qash.
phase2_deltas.absent_skus: One row per SELLABLE VARIANT with a composite id, not one row per product. See docs/phase2-feed-generator.md.
phase2_deltas.prices: price / sale_price from Shopify, tax columns dropped entirely. See scripts/check_feed_prices.py.
